content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Fully temporary arrangement until a regular teacher/arrangement is made in the school or till 31 March 2027 No appointment or posting order; formal instruction given by the School Management and Development Committee Committee may remove the candidate if work is not satisfactory No claim for regularisation will be accepted No leave except government holidays; honorarium cut proportionately for days absent

content_sections.heading: How Will District Education Officer Balod Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Scrutiny of applications by the head of institution and SMDC/SMC as per prescribed criteria Merit on the basis of percentage of marks in qualifying examinations as per the merit table High/Higher Secondary School posts: 20% of Higher Secondary percentage, 30% of graduation percentage, 50% of postgraduate percentage (100 marks) On equal marks the older candidate (by date of birth) gets the opportunity Five candidates kept in waiting list in order of merit, valid till 31 March 2027

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Recent colour passport-size photograph, self-attested Residence certificate Attested copy of caste certificate issued by the competent authority Chhattisgarh domicile certificate, if any Self-attested copies of date of birth, educational qualification, training and other certificates Consent letter as per prescribed criteria and service conditions

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for District Education Officer Balod Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Fill the application form printed on pages 10-11 of the notice, addressed to the Principal/Head of Institution of the school applied for. Paste a recent colour passport-size photograph, self-attested. Attach the residence certificate, caste certificate and self-attested copies of other certificates. Attach the consent letter as per the prescribed criteria and service conditions. Submit the application in person at the office of the head of institution/principal of the concerned school by 04:00 PM on 16-11-2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Advertised posts are changeable; the number of posts may be increased or decreased Entire eligibility process is done by SMDC/SMC All documents must be self-attested Honorarium is paid on attendance certified by the committee and the head of institution/principal Arrangement approved by the Collector

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for District Education Officer Balod Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in District Education Officer Balod Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 93 vacancies: 46 Sangwari Guruji (Lecturer), 26 Sangwari Guruji (Teacher), 21 Sangwari Guruji (Assistant Teacher).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for District Education Officer Balod Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Application form on pages 10-11 of this notice) and send it to Office of the Principal / Head of Institution of the concerned school, District Balod (C.G.), by by hand (in person), to reach by 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 21 to 40 years (as on 1 January 2026).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: 20000 for Sangwari Guruji (Lecturer), 18000 for Sangwari Guruji (Teacher), 15000 for Sangwari Guruji (Assistant Teacher).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Lecturer: second-division postgraduate degree in the relevant subject and B.Ed. Teacher: graduation with at least 45% with the relevant subject(s), B.Ed. and TET. Assistant Teacher: Higher Secondary (or equivalent) with at least 45% marks, two-year Diploma in Elementary Education as per NCTE Regulations, 2002, and TET. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only candidates residing in the concerned development block are eligible; applications from other blocks/districts are not accepted. If no eligible candidate is found from the block in the first invitation, candidates from other blocks of Balod district may be taken. Residence certificate must be attached with the application.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates of other development blocks or districts (except as allowed if no eligible candidate is found in the first invitation).

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Scrutiny of applications by the head of institution and SMDC/SMC as per prescribed criteria. Merit on the basis of percentage of marks in qualifying examinations as per the merit table. High/Higher Secondary School posts: 20% of Higher Secondary percentage, 30% of graduation percentage, 50% of postgraduate percentage (100 marks). On equal marks the older candidate (by date of birth) gets the opportunity.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Fully temporary arrangement until a regular teacher/arrangement is made in the school or till 31 March 2027. No appointment or posting order; formal instruction given by the School Management and Development Committee. Committee may remove the candidate if work is not satisfactory.
